headline: Last session: Sensex plunged 1,484 points while Nifty dropped below 25,400 amid broad-based sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Dalal Street witnessed a sharp broad-based sell-off during the last trading session.
Metal and banking sectors faced severe selling pressure.
Investors lost over ₹6 lakh crore in cumulative market capitalization.
Sensex crashed over 1,600 points from its intraday high.
whatHappening: In the previous session, Sensex closed down 1,484 points while Nifty slipped below 25,400.
Metal and bank stocks were the worst hit, while IT stocks outshone the broader market.
SEBI requested intermediaries to stop publishing IPO Grey Market Premium (GMP).
Mahanadi Coalfields IPO achieved full subscription on its final bidding day.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices witnessed a sharp sell-off, with the Sensex plunging 1,484 points and Nifty closing below 25,400. Investors lost over ₹6 lakh crore as metal and bank stocks faced heavy selling, while IT stocks showed relative strength. The stock market is closed today for an NSE holiday and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.
